title: He left IIT Bombay for a PhD in America. In 2026, one of the world's oldest honor societies inducted him.
sources: Penn State News, 2026 - Physicist Nitin Samarth elected to American Academy of Arts and Sciences
American Academy of Arts and Sciences - 2026 New Members list
caption:
He left IIT Bombay for a physics PhD in America. In 2026, he was elected to a society founded in 1780.

Nitin Samarth was elected to the American Academy of Arts and Sciences' 2026 class, in its Mathematical and Physical Sciences section. He holds the Verne M. Willaman Professorship of Physics at Penn State and has published roughly 300 papers on spin coherence in semiconductors and topological insulators, per Penn State's announcement. His path ran from a B.S. at IIT Bombay in 1980, to a PhD at Purdue, to leading Penn State's Physics Department for over a decade.

One of America's oldest honor societies just recognized a physics career that started with an IIT Bombay degree.
